The experiment data is trustworthy as the sample ratio check shows no significant imbalance between arms. However, moving the first gate from level 30 to level 40 does not appear to be a good idea based on this analysis. The primary metric (retention_7) shows no statistically significant difference between control and treatment groups (p-value: 0.991), with the treatment actually showing a slight decrease in retention rate (-0.02 percentage points). Furthermore, the experiment was not adequately powered to reliably detect the pre-registered effect size, meaning even if there were a meaningful impact, this study wouldn't have been sensitive enough to catch it.
